payload.reason: The evidence indicates that different variants of ROUGE scores yield varying correlation values with human judgments and manual evaluations, particularly in the context of scientific summarization.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE result in different correlation values with human judgments, indicating that not all ROUGE scores are equally effective.
ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 are better correlated with manual judgments in the context of scientific summarization compared to other variants.
Many variants of ROUGE scores do not have high correlations with human pyramid scores, indicating variability in effectiveness.
There is a large variance of correlations between different ROUGE variants and manual evaluations, affecting reliability for scientific summaries.
